title: Soldiers Reenlisted to Play GTA 6 (The GTA Flu Is Real) 🎮
description:
One Army unit offered a 4-day pass for the GTA 6 launch to soldiers who reenlisted for at least two more years. Twenty said yes. Meanwhile, almost 1 in 5 full-time workers plan to take launch day off, and half of gamers taking time off for a release say they'll call in sick.

Sources:
- CBS News: https://www.cbsnews.com/news/grand-theft-auto-army-reenlistment-bonus/
- Fortune (Army unit, Aug 2026): https://fortune.com/2026/08/20/grand-theft-auto-six-days-off-from-work-anticipating-gen-z-millennial-hype-rockstar-games-take-two-interactive/
- BambooHR, PTO requests for the GTA VI release: https://www.bamboohr.com/resources/data-at-work/data-stories/gta-pto
- Fast Company, everyone's taking PTO and sick days: https://www.fastcompany.com/91626090/everyones-taking-pto-and-sick-days-to-play-grand-theft-auto-vi
- Fortune (Logitech gaming day off, Nov 2026): https://fortune.com/2026/11/10/logitech-gaming-day-off-ahead-of-grand-theft-auto-six-release-ceo-hanneke-faber-boost-productivity/

#gta6 #gaming #worklife

sources.title: CBS News: Army unit offers 4-day pass to play Grand Theft Auto VI as reenlistment incentive
Fortune (20 Aug 2026): One U.S. Army unit is offering 4 days off to play Grand Theft Auto
BambooHR: Gamer's Day Off, PTO requests spike for the GTA VI release
Fast Company: Everyone's taking PTO and sick days to play GTA VI
Fortune (10 Nov 2026): Logitech is giving 7,000 employees the day off to play video games

notes: No game logos, characters or screenshots; generic gamepad without console branding; no real insignia; paperwork is an illustration ('THE OFFER'), not a reproduction of the real memo. Facts: 9th Brigade Engineer Battalion, 3rd Infantry Division, Fort Stewart, Georgia: special four-day pass timed to the GTA VI release for soldiers who reenlist (min. 2 years, up to 6, signing window Aug 1 - Nov 14, 2026); 20 soldiers chose it; 3ID spokesperson Lt. Col. Angel Tomko confirmed (CBS, Fortune). BambooHR survey (n=1,530 full-time US employees, Oct 9-20, 2026): 18% plan to take the GTA VI release day off ('almost one in five full-time workers'); 50% of gamers taking time off for an upcoming release plan to call in sick ('half the gamers taking off'). 'GTA flu' nickname: Fast Company. Logitech: ~7,000 employees get a gaming day off ('Logi Game Day'), CEO plans to game on Nov 19 (Fortune). GTA VI release: Nov 19, 2026. Published as an owner-requested extra on Wed Nov 18 (eve of launch).

questions.q: Did soldiers reenlist to get GTA 6 days off?
questions.a: Yes. One U.S. Army unit offered a 4-day pass timed to the GTA 6 launch to soldiers who reenlisted for at least two more years, and 20 soldiers signed up.

questions.q: How many people are taking work off for GTA 6?
questions.a: Almost 1 in 5 full-time workers said they plan to take launch day off, according to BambooHR data.
The "GTA flu" is the nickname for people calling in sick to play GTA 6 on launch day. About half of gamers taking time off for a release say they'll call in sick.
